tests.title: Member buys a package (quota) product and its remaining uses are tracked
tests.goal: Package products sold online give the member the right number of uses and each use is deducted once.
preconditions: A package/quota product found at runtime (CRM Products > Package view, e.g. 偈油x10)

steps.text: Buy 1 package as the member and pay (receipt accepted in the CRM, SCRM-075)
Open the member's package/quota balance on the eShop and in the CRM
Redeem one use in Web POS with the member and recheck the balance

expected.text: Step 2: the balance equals the package size (e.g. 10)
Step 3: the balance drops by exactly 1 and the redemption is in the history
Cleanup: refund the package order; the remaining quota is removed
